name: File Reader
description: Reads many files as one table: a list of files, a glob or a directory (recursively when 'recursive' is true). Supports csv, parquet and json (a JSON array or newline-delimited JSON); ORC and Avro are rejected with a conversion hint. Files are expanded in the engine, sorted, capped at 10000 and validated against the path allowlist, then read by DuckDB's streaming readers, so nothing is loaded into the heap. 'union_by_name' merges different schemas and 'filename' adds the source file column; CSV options mirror DuckDB read_csv.

path.title: Path
path.description: A file, a directory or a glob pattern such as /data/*.csv. Exactly one of 'path' or 'paths' is required.

paths.title: Paths
paths.description: Several files, directories or glob patterns.

format.title: Format
format.description: File format of every selected file.

recursive.title: Recursive
recursive.description: Walk a directory or a glob root recursively.

union_by_name.title: Union by name
union_by_name.description: Merge files with different schemas by column name instead of failing.

filename.title: Add filename
filename.description: Add a 'filename' column with the source file path.

header.title: Header
header.description: The first CSV line is a header row.

nullstr.title: Null string
nullstr.description: Text that reads as a missing value.

ignore_errors.title: Ignore errors
ignore_errors.description: Skip malformed CSV rows instead of failing.
